name: Berger Email Triage
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0-or-later self-hosted Rust email triage daemon with rule-based tagging, optional LLM classification, IMAP folder actions, webhook triggers, and Docker Compose deployment; no software usage quota published.
watch_out: Requires a separate running Bichon mail archiver, IMAP credentials and your own host. Optional LLM calls may incur provider fees. Modified network-served versions carry AGPL source-sharing obligations; no hosted compute or email account is included.
